what: TotalEnergies produces oil and gas, is a top-three player in liquefied natural gas (LNG), refines and sells fuels, and is building a large electricity business from renewables and gas plants.
customers: Utilities, industry, airlines, shipping and drivers, mainly in Europe and Africa.
moat: Low-cost production, a strong LNG portfolio and more progress in electricity than other oil majors.
opportunities: A dividend yield above 4% with consistent buybacks
One of the largest liquefied natural gas portfolios in the world
Analysts see about 16% upside from current levels
watch: LNG volumes and upstream production growth.
